svg.title: Forge UGC — Create UGC
svg.desc: Editable screen design matching the supplied Home SVG. Artwork and text are separate. Sample balances, items and prices are design placeholders; the game uses live player data.
svg.text: Describe one accessory. We'll turn it into 3D.
Try: a crystal crown with glowing blue gems...
Confirm the price in Roblox before paying.
AI creates it. You make it yours.
